BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulating liquefied petroleum gas; adding a newchapter to Title 19 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Clearly excessive price" means a price which exceeds onehundred and fifteen percent of the price per MBtu charged to a personwho owns their own liquefied gas container. (2) "Cylinder" means a portable container that is constructed toUnited States department of transportation specifications that has lessthan two hundred thirtynine pounds of water capacity and that iscapable of storing liquefied petroleum gas. (3) "Liquefied petroleum gas" means any hydrocarbon or mixture ofhydrocarbons composed predominantly of propane, propylene, butanes,normal butane, isobutane, or butylenes. (4) "Person" means a natural person, corporation, partnership,firm, receiver, trustee, or any organized group of persons.

(1) A person, other than the owner of aliquefied petroleum gas container or a person authorized in writing bythe owner, may not: (a) Fill or refill a liquefied petroleum gas container withliquefied petroleum gas or any other gas or compound; or (b) Deface, erase, obliterate, cover up, or otherwise remove orconceal any name, mark, initial, or device on a liquefied petroleum gas container. (2) This section does not apply to cylinders. (3) A person violating this section is subject to a one thousanddollar fine payable to the county where the violation occurs.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 19 RCW.
